title: lycopodium clavatum var. robustius
intro: Lycopodium clavatum var. robustius, commonly known as robust club moss or robust lycopodium, is a variety of the lycopodium clavatum plant, which is a type of club moss that belongs to the lycopodiopsida division of ancient vascular plants. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of robust club moss include reducing inflammation, treating respiratory issues, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, such as lycopterine and lycoperoside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to confirm its effectiveness and safety.
